name: Diaspora freighter (placeholder)
note: A slow freighter for escort missions (the Tamsin in the escort test mission). A placeholder hull (Game/PlaceholderShips.Hull 140 x 36 x 30 m) with no part models: its two turrets, engines, sensors, comms and bridge are combat parts placed on the hull boxes. Defence and part shares are FS2's GTFR Triton's (ships.tbl): hull 5,000, no shield, one flak and one laser turret. sizeClass corvette so the AI treats it as a big ship (fighters keep off its hull, bombers make runs on it).

geometry.about: Boxes round the placeholder hull: the engine block, the plated body, the blunt nose. Unity axes, nose +z.

partsSource: hpPercent: turrets 1% of hull each (ships.tbl GTFR Triton $Subsystem turret01/turret02 1); engines 30 split over two pods, sensors 10, communications 10, navigation 5 as the bridge (Triton $Subsystem engine 30, sensors 10, communications 10, navigation 5)
